description: The x- vendor namespace of SPEC section 8(2) is a reserved extension point, not a typo: a key matching ^x-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)+$ is preserved verbatim through a lossless export, is never interpreted, and never raises the AGSC-E207 unknown-key warning. Every other unknown key still warns under AGSC-02-05, and a key that fails the general name pattern is still AGSC-E204.

frontmatter.description: An item carrying one reserved vendor extension key and one ordinary unknown key.
frontmatter.title: Vendor keys
